timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet signs the Guildpact and founds the Izzet League.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet was an original signatory of the Guildpact

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guilds return to ascendance; most get new guildmasters except the Izzet, Orzhov and Rakdos.
timeline.quote: the guilds returned and became ascendant

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Juzba explains the blazekite as vehicular dragscoop ionics.
timeline.quote: The blazekite is a simple concept, really

citation.text: Wee Dragonauts (Arena League 2006, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Myznar reports an experiment run through a lab-goblin's brain as a success.
timeline.quote: My burners' flames fell asleep while the beakers jumped about and shattered.

citation.text: Schismotivate (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Izzet League buys the entire goblin tribe, impressed by their cleverness, per legend.
timeline.quote: The cleverness of the ancient goblins impressed the magelords enough that the Izzet League purchased the entire tribe outright.

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Izzet Goblins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During his absence Niv-Mizzet uses the Firemind to give guildmages mysterious new projects.
timeline.quote: During his absence, he used the power of the Firemind to reach out to his guildmages with a complex array of new and mysterious projects for the Izzet League to work on.

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Return to Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet drives the Izzet to delve into ever more dangerous and experimental magic for unknown purposes.
timeline.quote: their guild leader, Niv-Mizzet , has driven the Izzet to delve deeper and deeper into more dangerous and experimental magic

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 2", section "The Izzet League". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal watches the Izzet from an abandoned Orzhov spire, sent by his clan leader to make sure they do not encroach on Zhur-Taa territory.
timeline.quote: Kal was sent to watch the Izzet by his clan leader, Nikya of the Old Ways

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kal channels what he learned from the Izzet into a fire-and-lightning spell that incinerates the flailer, the demons and the remaining Rakdos.
timeline.quote: A blast of fire incinerated the grinning flailer.

citation.text: "Gruul Ingenuity". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Dec 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: On opening night the play's audience is thin and Ilona is in the balcony, leaving Symond in debt; he flees.
timeline.quote: Only a quarter of the seats were occupied, but there, sitting in her balcony seat, was Ilona.

citation.text: "Bilagru Will Come for You". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tarem demands she acquit an unknown accused in an Izzet League theft case as payment.
timeline.quote: you will find him innocent of all charges. This will mark the end of our transaction.

citation.text: "Expectations". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The snapjaw eats two workers and a handler, so the drudge-monitor plans to herd it into Izzet territory.
timeline.quote: Then it ate the handler.

citation.text: "Paper Trail". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Stanisil removes most Izzet mechanisms from the snapjaw, which begins to develop humanoid features and near-sapience.
timeline.quote: I believe that it is on the verge of demonstrating sapience.

citation.text: "Paper Trail". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia splits the legion into four theatres to deal with threats to public order.
timeline.quote: Aurelia has split leadership of the bulk of the legion into four

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek becomes the Izzet's new guildmaster after over 10,000 years.
timeline.quote: the Izzet League had a new guildmaster, Ral Zarek

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal is assigned by Nikya to spy on the Izzet near the Rubblebelt and watches them from a ruined spire.
timeline.quote: Kal was assigned a job by Nikya of the Old Ways to spy on the Izzet

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mr. Taz offers Krenko another job at an Orzhov bank, and an Izzet portal opens nearby.
timeline.quote: an Izzet experiment unintentionally opened a portal nearby

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leighbet loses her Izzet position after a daring experiment goes wrong and sets up an unsanctioned lab.
timeline.quote: the loss of her position within the Izzet League

citation.text: "Leighbet", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator recounts his father turning him out for lacking Izzet aptitude.
timeline.quote: When it became patently obvious even to him that I didn't have the Izzet aptitude, he turned me out onto the streets.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "8 Prazh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Izzet discover Azor I's contingency plan; the power of a new Guildpact is bestowed on Jace, who becomes the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: That power was eventually bestowed upon Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Guildpact reinstated". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek leads the Izzet against Bolas in the War of the Spark and convinces the Simic to join.
timeline.quote: convinced the Simic Combine to join as well

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leighbet demands a promotion from Master Dax, is fired and loses her access and title, and starts an unsanctioned lab in the boilerpit beneath her apartment.
timeline.quote: that just leaves you standing at the front steps of the Lightning Rod, a box full of your desk belongings in your arms.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin identifies Bazda's artifact as ancient Izzet technology and calls it priceless.
timeline.quote: I've seen them before on ancient Izzet machinery

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Utvara is devastated by a Simic-origin plague worsened by Gruul encroachment and is declared a reclamation zone.
timeline.quote: Utvara was devastated by a Simic -origin plague.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Izzet return after discovering three unhatched dragon eggs and build the Cauldron.
timeline.quote: the Izzet established the Cauldron , a massive steamworks complex built into the Utvara Flats

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion many Simic and Izzet members willingly undergo compleation, causing distrust from other guilds.
timeline.quote: many Simic willingly underwent compleation to gain more insight into the mutagen

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska welcomes curious Simic and Izzet volunteers while others flee in terror.
timeline.quote: I motion to welcome them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Numerous Izzet willingly undergo compleation out of curiosity, earning distrust from other guilds.
timeline.quote: numerous Izzet willingly underwent compleation out of sheer curiosity, resulting in great distrust from the other guilds.

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Phyrexian Invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral curtails individual research, sparking intense guild conflict and defections.
timeline.quote: sparking intense guild conflict and prompting the defection of numerous members.

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Phyrexian Invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An emergency led to the Thinktank Enclave's temporary and then permanent sovereignty from the Izzet.
timeline.quote: Formerly run by the Izzet, an emergency prompted the temporary and subsequently permanent sovereignty of this city.

citation.text: "Precinct Five", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The reader learns Niv-Mizzet has taken over a Ninth District courtyard and had it sealed.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet has been doing something strange in a courtyard in the Ninth District.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The reader finds that the focus of the research is just a door.
timeline.quote: It's a door. Just a door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: On another path, the reader leaves the courtyard and goes to a coffee shop.
timeline.quote: You turn around and head for your favorite coffee shop, where you place your order.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.
